name: Kazerne Pieter
description: A beige concrete-and-brick fire station on Poeldijkstraat, with five red glazed fire-engine doors, a projecting glazed watchroom and a setback upper room. It opened on 10 May 1972 to replace the fire stations in Sloten and Oud Osdorp.
funFact: Pieter gets its name from the code letter P for Poeldijkstraat. The station formerly housed a hose workshop, shoemaker and clothing depot; its current specialist role is responding to incidents involving hazardous substances.
